data.one_liner: Flutter client for ASP.NET Core SignalR supporting WebSocket, SSE, LongPolling and MessagePack.
data.what_it_does: Provides a SignalR client that can invoke hub methods and receive server callbacks. Supports automatic reconnect, multiple transport protocols and optional MessagePack serialization.
use_when: Real‑time communication with an ASP.NET Core SignalR server
Cross‑platform apps (mobile, desktop, web) requiring SignalR
avoid_when: Only simple REST/HTTP calls are needed
Targeting platforms where SignalR headers aren’t supported without work‑arounds
strengths: Works on Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, Linux, and Web
weaknesses: Limited to ASP.NET Core SignalR servers
Web platform header handling can be tricky
Documentation focuses on basic usage, advanced scenarios sparse
data.setup_notes: Add the package, import signalr_client, configure HubConnectionBuilder with URL and optional HttpConnectionOptions (e.g., logging, token).

alternatives.name: web_socket_channel
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides raw WebSocket connectivity without SignalR protocol overhead.
